Disappointing Stay – Poor Service and Cleanliness Issues

I had a very disappointing experience during my stay at this hotel. I checked in late, and despite that, I received a call at 10 AM the next morning informing me that I had to check out by 11 AM because I had only paid ₹3,000. This felt abrupt and inconsiderate.

The air conditioning in the room was not working the entire night. A technician was sent, but they were unable to fix the issue. While I was willing to tolerate that, the problems didn’t end there.

The new receptionist was extremely rude and unhelpful. There were no basic amenities in the bathroom — not even soap or shampoo. I didn’t complain about that, but then something truly disturbing happened. While I was using the washroom, a lizard fell on my shoulder and there was also a spider. I reported this to the receptionist, and her response was, “We can’t do anything about that.”

When I mentioned these issues at checkout and asked to speak to a manager, I was told no one was available and that nothing could be done. I even offered to share my experience with incoming guests just to make them aware, but was dismissed again.

Overall, this stay was extremely unpleasant, and I would not recommend this hotel to anyone. The lack of basic hospitality, poor cleanliness, and indifferent attitude of the staff made it a very negative experience.
